shape: No warmup and no restart: a single begin_new_match at tick 1, total_rounds_played counts from 0
Warmup then restart: two begin_new_match, a warmup round_end at total_rounds_played 0, and warmup deaths that share a live round's number
Warmup then restart, long regulation match (23 live rounds)
Knife round: three begin_new_match, a knife round_end at total_rounds_played 1 before the live start, stored starting side
Gauntlet knife round: three begin_new_match, no stored starting side (inferred from the demo)
No begin_new_match event at all: matchStartTick falls back to 0, total_rounds_played counts from 1
Multi-segment gauntlet match: a server restart splits the recording in two, each segment with its own tick space and its own begin_new_match sequence
